title: Ordinary scalar coordinates for an integral constant model
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of the l-adic numbers, with valuation ring A and its continuous condensed coefficient ring [def-sfb-finite-model-quotient-coordinates]. For any scheme T and any finitely presented internal module Q over the scalar ring Lambda(*) [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model], there is a finitely presented ordinary A-module P such that the canonical finiteConstantScalarExtension of Q on T is isomorphic to the specified modelFunctor applied to P [def-sfb-finite-constant-model-data]. Zero ranks, torsion modules and empty schemes are included.

source.place: Local models: the constant scalar module underlying each local model; first two sentences.

proof.text: Take a finite free presentation of Q. Use the regular-module universal property to express its matrix entries as sections of the scalar ring. The scalar realization identifies its cokernel with the cokernel of the scalar matrix on T. The same scalar entries give a finite free matrix over the continuous coefficient ring at the profinite point. Monoidal inverse image sends that matrix to the scalar matrix on T and preserves its cokernel. These are the existing scalarMatrix_map and pointMatrix_map comparisons.

The pointwise matrix cokernel is finitely presented by its displayed presentation. Apply continuousScalarFinitePresentation to obtain a finitely presented ordinary A-module P and its continuous scalar realization. Pull this isomorphism to T and compose the cokernel comparisons. The resulting realization is definitionally the specified modelFunctor.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_scalar_model_coordinates
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (Q : Mod Ab.{u + 1} (scalarRingObj (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E)))
    (hQ : Mod.IsFinitelyPresented (scalarRingObj (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E)) Q) :
    ∃ P : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A l E), Module.FinitePresentation (A l E) P ∧
      Nonempty ((finiteConstantScalarExtension (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) T).obj Q ≅
        model l E T P)
